title: OL-20261114-2: three foundation tests fail on main (pins, autorun, repo_cleanup)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** foundation tests red on main
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/foundation -p test_pins.py
**Status:** open

Found 2026-11-14 while landing SELF-REFERENCE-1; test_upstream is OL-20261114-1. Fix each at its root and keep the foundation test step green.
